serverInfo.name: smklog-quotes
serverInfo.title: SMKlog Parcel Shipping Rates
serverInfo.description: Live USPS, UPS, FedEx and DHL Express shipping rates for a parcel sent from a US address — inside the US, or to Canada, the UK, Germany or Australia — described in plain words. No scale, no account and no API key. Also reports how a checkout it prepared is going, tracks shipments bought on SMKlog and serves a monthly US parcel shipping price index.

instructions: Five tools. get_parcel_quote returns live shipping rates for a single parcel sent from a US origin — inside the US, or to Canada, the UK, Germany or Australia — across USPS, UPS and FedEx (plus DHL Express to Germany and Australia), from a plain-words item description (or exact dimensions). create_checkout_link turns one shipment into a prefilled checkout URL where the human pays for the shipping label; hand it the quote_id from get_parcel_quote and it reuses that quote instead of spending a second carrier call, and it returns a session_id. get_checkout_status takes that session_id and reports whether the human has paid and whether the label exists, with the tracking number once it does. track_parcel reports delivery status and scan events for a shipment whose label was bought on smklog.com. get_price_index returns the monthly SMKlog parcel shipping price index (a six-box basket priced to five US cities) for reference answers — reading it spends no quote allowance. Quotes are rate limited and cost real money to produce — call get_parcel_quote once per shipment, not per variation. SMKlog sells parcel labels only: a shipment past parcel limits or described as a pallet or freight load comes back as mode not_a_parcel with no rates (SMKlog does not arrange pallet or freight shipments), and more than one box comes back as mode multiple_boxes — one label per box, so quote each box on its own. Prices are checkout totals with the SMKlog fee inside; the fee is itemized only on the checkout receipt, and where the carrier publishes a counter price for the same parcel it is returned beside the rate so you can show what the person saves. Labels are purchased at https://smklog.com/assets/calculator.
